status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Improve ALG Note view layout, detail modal behavior, recognition badge display, and recognition editing.
assumptions: 1L3T detail headers include group and parity, for example [O-even] Os+.
LBT and future algsets show only the group name in detail headers until a later rule is defined.
Recognition editing is limited to tags.recognition, not other tag metadata such as sourceGroup, parity, or typeCode.

tasks.title: Stack compact group sections vertically
tasks.summary: In compact view, stack group sections vertically and keep only cards inside each group arranged in a horizontal grid.
verify: Compact view shows O-even, O-odd, V-even, and V-odd as vertical sections.
Cards inside each group still wrap horizontally.
No group header column stretches down beside unrelated groups.

tasks.title: Remove developer empty-state text
tasks.summary: Remove internal developer script path text from the user-facing empty state.
verify: Empty state does not show scripts/build_app_data.py.
A short user-facing failure message remains or the empty state is otherwise unobtrusive.

tasks.title: Center detail modal
protected_fields: stored edits schema except fields needed by this task
tasks.summary: Open compact card details with left click in a viewport-centered floating modal. Long content scrolls inside the modal.
verify: Left-clicking a compact card opens details.
The modal stays centered regardless of page scroll position.
Long detail content scrolls inside the modal instead of the page.
The modal can be closed.

tasks.title: Simplify detail header
protected_fields: normal full-view card metadata unless explicitly needed
tasks.summary: Show concise detail headers: [group-parity] case name for 1L3T and [group] case name for LBT or other algsets.
verify: 1L3T detail header shows values like [O-even] Os+.
LBT detail header shows only group name and case name.
The old id/type/parity meta line is not shown in the detail header.

tasks.title: Add recognition badges
protected_fields: filter option generation except recognition label display if needed
tasks.summary: Show only recognition badges at the bottom of the detail modal and apply the chosen tag colors.
verify: Detail modal shows recognition as a badge near the bottom.
E_noT is white with readable text and border.
E_onlyT is pink.
E_opp is light green.
E_same is sky blue.
O_back is black with readable text.
O_opp is green.
O_same is blue.
O_side is red.

tasks.title: Edit recognition tag
tasks.summary: In edit mode, allow adding, changing, or removing tags.recognition along with setup and algorithms.
verify: Editing recognition persists after reload.
Removing recognition persists after reload.
JSON export includes the edited tags.recognition.
Other tag fields are preserved unchanged.

tasks.title: Fix recognition view overlap
protected_fields: recognition grouping logic except layout metadata
tasks.summary: In detailed recognition view, stack recognition sections vertically and arrange cards horizontally inside each section to prevent overlap.
verify: Detailed view ON with recognition view shows sections stacked vertically.
Cards inside each recognition section do not overlap.
Column count still applies within each recognition section where appropriate.
